fields.description: Shahrukhz is Danube’s commercial office tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, separate from Shahrukhz Residences in Dubai Maritime City. Workspaces range from compact offices to larger floor configurations, with meeting, networking and leisure facilities.

overview: Danube lists 615 commercial units in a 55-storey tower. Its internal inspection dated 30 September 2026 reported 9% progress, completed shoring, piling nearing completion and excavation underway. This is a dated developer report.
research.locationNote: Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Sufouh, as identified by the developer’s linked map. This is not the Maritime City residential project.
research.priceNote: The developer advertises AED 1.9m from-price. Current inventory, fit-out scope, service charges and unit-specific quotation remain unverified.
research.paymentNote: Brochure: 70% by completion, 30% afterward; 1% monthly headline. Current unit-specific milestones and eligibility require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Brochure target: Q2 2029; developer page: 2029. Actual handover remains unverified.
